colophons.text:
Artist's inscription, signature and two seals: Imitating Kao Fan-shan's [Kao K'o-kung's] brush at Liu-yün-ho [Valley of Lingering Clouds] during a spring day in the kuei-yu year [1633].  Yen-shan, T'ao Hung [seals] T'ao Hung chih-yin; tzu Ch'iu-shui.  
(Translated by Wai-Kam Ho)
